meta.title: Anki
meta.description: Native headless Anki workspace with a bundled Anki core: browse, edit, add and review notes, import/export APKG, and sync with AnkiWeb.

title: Anki workspace
subtitle: Your local collection. A little progress, every day.
noDecks: No decks yet. Create your first deck below.
deleteReturned: Filtered-deck cards returned to their original decks
deleteFilteredHint: Cards in filtered decks are returned to their original decks, not deleted. The deletion counts shown apply only to cards and orphaned notes actually removed.
deleteWarning: Export an APKG backup before proceeding. Review Undo cannot undo this deletion. If synchronization is enabled, deletion may propagate to AnkiWeb and other devices.
deleteConfirmName: Type the exact full deck name to confirm
deleteDefault: The Default deck (ID 1), and any deck containing it, cannot be deleted.
deleteChanged: The deck contents or confirmation changed. Refresh and preview again.
deleteFailed: Deletion preview or deletion failed. Refresh and preview again before retrying.
searchHint: Uses Anki search syntax. The selected deck is included in your search.
noNotes: No notes found. Try another search or add a note.
selectNote: Select a note to edit its fields, tags, or suspension state.
fieldHint: Fields accept Anki HTML. Imported card scripts are never executed.
clozeHint: Cloze example: The capital of France is {{c1::Paris}}.
added: Note added. Ready for the next one.
addHint: Choose a deck and note type, then fill in the fields.
noModels: No note types are available. Refresh the collection or import a deck.
reviewHint: Recall the answer first, then reveal it and choose an honest rating.
question: Question
reviewEmptyHint: No cards are available for this selection right now.
reviewIdleHint: Choose a deck to study it and its subdecks. All decks is only for browsing and export.
mediaNotice: Some media could not be loaded. Only bounded local media is supported; external URLs and scripts are blocked.
safeCard: Isolated card · no scripts or external resources
transferNotice: This is an independent local collection, not your desktop Anki collection. Optional AnkiWeb synchronization is available in Sync. Custom JavaScript, MathJax and add-ons are not supported.
importHint: Place your own .apkg file in the imports directory shown above, then enter its filename only. This panel does not upload files or accept arbitrary file paths. Import merges into and changes the current collection. A pre-import collection backup is kept in the private data/backups directory. Imported media cannot be atomically undone with the collection.
exportHint: Export the selected deck, or All decks. The Host saves the package locally and returns its path.
filenameError: Use a filename ending in .apkg, without a directory path.
fieldsRequired: Fill in at least one field.
modifiedError: The note has no numeric revision. Reload the note before saving.
transportError: The Anki Host service returned an invalid response.
unknownError: The operation failed. Please try again.
notReadyHint: Check that the local Anki service is running, then retry.
selectDeckHint: Select a deck to rename it or narrow your workspace.
syncIntro: Connect this independent collection to your AnkiWeb account. Account actions are sent directly to the authenticated Host, never through an AI tool.
syncCredentialsHint: Enter credentials only here, not in chat. The password is cleared on submission and is not saved in browser storage.
syncLoginFailed: Could not sign in. Check your credentials, connection, and secure credential storage, then try again.
syncFailed: Synchronization could not finish. Check your connection and account, then refresh the sync status or retry.
syncAuthError: Sign in again to continue synchronization.
syncBusyError: A synchronization job is using the collection. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
syncConfirmError: This full-sync confirmation has expired or changed. Refresh the status and choose again.
syncAutoHint: The Host manages automatic synchronization, even when this panel is closed. This page only checks progress; it does not schedule sync jobs.
syncFullHint: Normal sync cannot merge these collections. No direction will be chosen automatically. Review both sides before continuing.
syncEmptyHint: Your local collection is empty. Download is recommended to keep the existing AnkiWeb collection.
syncUploadWarning: Full upload replaces the collection on AnkiWeb with this local collection. Other devices will need to download it. The backup protects only the local collection, NOT the cloud collection. An empty local upload can erase your cloud notes.
syncDownloadWarning: Full download replaces this local collection with the AnkiWeb collection. A pre-sync local collection backup is kept, but media changes are not atomically undoable. Unsaved editor drafts must be reloaded after sync.
syncConsent: I understand the replacement and backup limitations, and explicitly authorize this direction.
syncDecisionBanner: Synchronization requires an explicit full upload or download decision. Collection changes and review are paused.
syncChanged: Synchronization may have changed the collection. Your editor draft is preserved, but its version is stale. Reload the note before saving; reloading discards the current draft.
